India defeats Pakistan 7-1 in FIH Pro League hockey match

The Indian men's hockey team secured a decisive 7-1 victory over Pakistan in the FIH Pro League. After conceding an early goal, India responded with seven goals from different players to secure the win. This match was part of the FIH Pro League.
